notes: Batch held 15 groups, not 16. Every group got at least one fetch of its own site. Liveness data from the batch was used as a starting point and checked: Athletic Base Ball's sitemap lastmod 2026-05-18 is confirmed (not an event, so probably_active); History First Hand's domain does not resolve. Two WebSearch calls were used (both of the 2 allowed): Bottle Underground (no matching Philadelphia group found, so held back without summary) and Mantua Theater Project (led to the Drexel partner page, which was read). Four groups are hidden as private: Barefoot Artists, Black Starr Inc (the tax-form website is a disaster relief site whose name does not match the legal name, so it was not treated as this group's own), Louise Nevelson Foundation, and Nile Valley Collective. Erehwon Ensemble is out of area (Kingston, NY). No rate limiting was seen; the errors were per site (TLS and DNS). Budget: 24 fetches of 60, 2 searches of 2.
